import pytest

import inventory


def test_reserva_persiste_a_baixa():

    assert inventory.STOCK['sku-1'] == 6


def test_insuficiente_nao_altera_saldo():
    inventory.STOCK['sku-2'] = 3
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        inventory.reserve('sku-2', 5)
    assert inventory.STOCK['sku-2'] == 3
